note: Part 2 of the catalogue: peering, private endpoints, NAT, public IPs, Application Gateway, Front Door, Load Balancer, VPN and ExpressRoute, Firewall, Bastion, DDoS IP Protection, DNS and data transfer.

types.label: Virtual network peering
types.note: Data in and out through the peering, per GB. Inter-region peering is priced for the catalogue region's zone; other zones differ.

inputs.label: Inbound data
inputs.help: Data received over the peering a month.

inputs.label: Outbound data
inputs.help: Data sent over the peering a month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Virtual Network' and (armRegionName eq '{region}' or armRegionName eq 'Global')

types.label: Private endpoint
types.note: Endpoint hours and data processed in each direction (first volume tier). Private Link service and fixed-bandwidth endpoints are not included.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Virtual Network' and (armRegionName eq '{region}' or armRegionName eq 'Global')

types.label: NAT gateway
types.note: Gateway hours and data processed. The public IPs it uses are separate resources.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'NAT Gateway' and (armRegionName eq '{region}' or armRegionName eq 'Global')

types.label: Public IP address
types.note: IPv4 addresses billed per hour. Public IP prefixes are not included.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Virtual Network' and (armRegionName eq '{region}' or armRegionName eq 'Global')

types.label: Application Gateway v2
types.note: The fixed hourly charge plus capacity units (enter the average number running). v1 gateways, Application Gateway for Containers and the discounted WAF policy rate are not included.

inputs.label: Capacity units
inputs.help: Average capacity units in use across the month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Application Gateway' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Front Door Standard and Premium
types.note: Base fee, requests and edge-to-client data transfer, first volume tier. Billed by zone: this uses Zone 1 (North America and Europe). Custom domains, WAF policies and rules, origin transfer and the classic tiers are not included.

inputs.label: Profiles
inputs.help: Front Door profiles billed the base fee.

inputs.label: Requests
inputs.help: Requests a month, in tens of thousands.

inputs.label: Data transfer out
inputs.help: Data sent from the edge to clients a month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Azure Front Door Service' and armRegionName eq '{region}'
retail.regionNote: Front Door is billed by zone; the Retail API lists Zone 1 (North America and Europe) rather than a region.

types.label: Load Balancer
types.note: Standard and Global: the charge that covers the first five rules, rules beyond five, and data processed. Gateway Load Balancer and the free Basic tier are not included.

inputs.label: Load balancers
inputs.help: Load balancers billed the base charge (includes five rules).

inputs.label: Extra rules
inputs.help: Load-balancing and outbound rules beyond the first five, across all balancers.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Load Balancer' and (armRegionName eq '{region}' or armRegionName eq 'Global')

base.meterName: ^Standard Included LB Rules and Outbound Rules$

rules.meterName: ^Standard Overage LB Rules and Outbound Rules$

base.meterName: ^Global Included LB Rules and Outbound Rules$

rules.meterName: ^Global Overage LB Rules and Outbound Rules$

data.free: The Retail API lists Global data processed at 0.

types.label: VPN Gateway
types.note: Gateway hours. Site-to-site and point-to-site connections beyond those included, and the advanced connectivity add-on, are not included.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'VPN Gateway' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: ExpressRoute gateway
types.note: Virtual network gateway hours. ErGwScale is priced per scale unit (at least two).

inputs.label: Gateways or scale units
inputs.help: Gateways, or ErGwScale scale units, billed per hour.

types.label: ExpressRoute circuit
types.note: The monthly circuit fee by bandwidth and plan. Metered plans also bill outbound data per GB, which is not included; the unlimited plan has no data charge. Billed by zone: this uses Zone 1. ExpressRoute Direct, Global Reach and the gateway (separate type) are not included.

retail.regionNote: ExpressRoute circuits are billed by zone; the Retail API lists Zone 1 (North America and Europe) rather than a region.

types.label: Azure Firewall
types.note: Deployment hours and data processed for Basic, Standard and Premium. Secured virtual hub deployments and capacity units are not included.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Azure Firewall' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Azure Bastion
types.note: Host hours and additional scale-out instances. Outbound data transfer is billed as internet egress.

inputs.label: Additional instances
inputs.help: Scale-out instances beyond the two included, billed per hour.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Azure Bastion' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

extra.free: Basic does not scale beyond two instances.

types.label: DDoS IP Protection
types.note: Per protected public IP address. The Retail API has no DDoS meter and the Network Protection price (which covers 100 IPs) was not published in the page text, so only IP Protection is listed. Vendor price, not verified against a meter.

inputs.label: Protected IPs
inputs.help: Public IP addresses with DDoS IP Protection.

types.label: Azure DNS
types.note: Hosted zones (first 25 zones; the lower rate beyond is not applied) and queries (first billion). Record sets and Private Resolver endpoints are not included. Billed by zone: this uses Zone 1.

inputs.label: Queries
inputs.help: DNS queries a month, in millions.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Azure DNS' and armRegionName eq '{region}'
retail.regionNote: Azure DNS is billed by zone; the Retail API lists Zone 1 rather than a region.

types.label: Data transfer out (internet and between regions)
types.note: Outbound data per GB. The Microsoft global network tiers are volume bands: pick the band that matches the month's total (the first 100 GB are free and the band above 100 GB is the `egress-gb` price). Inbound data is free. Continent-specific rates differ.

inputs.label: Data out
inputs.help: Data sent out a month, within the chosen band.
